confirmed: Only Administrators and Legal Team Members open the staff Knowledge record: the loader redirects other roles to /, and publish, unpublish, archive and restore use requireMember. There is no approval step. (knowledge-record.tsx knowledgeRecordLoader; knowledge/routes.ts)

Knowledge Item actions offers Publish on a draft, Unpublish on a published item, Archive on a live item and Restore on an archived item. (knowledge-record.tsx; messages knowledge.actions and knowledge.action.*)
Draft marker shows for a draft; On the portal shows only for published, Everyone, not archived; Archived shows for an archived item. (knowledge-record.tsx subbar)

Audience select offers Legal Only and Everyone. Changing to Legal Only, or Unpublish, opens Remove this from the portal? with the deflection link count, Cancel and Continue, only when deflectionLinkCount > 0. (knowledge-record.tsx requestAudience, requestUnpublish, reach dialog)

Settings, Intake, Deflection links (/settings/intake/links) has Add link with Target (External address / Knowledge item), Label and Placement (Portal home or a request type). Administrator only. (settings-intake-links.tsx; intake-settings-tabs.tsx; intake-links/routes.ts)
Portal home and request forms draw the Before you submit panel; a Knowledge link opens /portal/knowledge/:id in the same tab. (deflection-panel.tsx; portal.tsx; portal-request-form.tsx)

The Portal article and each download apply one gate: published, Everyone, not archived (portalKnowledgeScope). Anything else answers 404 and the page redirects to /portal; no session redirects to /portal/login. Deflection links to an unreachable item drop out of the panel but stay in Settings. (portal/routes.ts reachableLink; portal-knowledge.tsx loader)

The Portal article lists Documents (primary first) before Guidance, current Versions only, with Download buttons and no staff or Version controls. (portal-knowledge.tsx; portal/routes.ts getPortalKnowledge)

Archive dialog: Archive Knowledge Item, Replaced by, No replacement, Cancel and Archive. Choices reload every time the dialog opens (dd961fee). The API refuses an archived replacement with 'The replacement must be a live Knowledge Item.', and the dialog shows that detail in an alert. (knowledge-record.tsx setArchiveOpen and runAction; knowledge/routes.ts replacementForArchive)

Archive disables Title, Type, Folder, Audience and guidance editing; Restore clears archivedAt only, so publication state and audience return unchanged. (knowledge-record.tsx; knowledge/routes.ts restore)
The staff Knowledge list excludes archived items and its query has no archived filter; an archived record still opens by its address. (knowledge/service.ts listScope; KnowledgeListQuery)
A failed lifecycle action now shows the API's own detail, falling back to 'The Knowledge Item could not be changed.' (knowledge-record.tsx runAction)
Portal routes require a session and serve every signed-in role in a reader capacity; Everyone is not an anonymous page. (portal/routes.ts requireAuth; KNW-004 addendum)
limitations: Source inspection only. It does not replace the independent browser walkthrough V-C34 needs at 067c1646.

The registry asks for an out-of-audience comparison reader. OpenLaw has no per-person Knowledge audience: Everyone means every signed-in Portal session. The walkthrough can compare a Portal reader against an item in Draft, Legal Only or Archived state, and against a browser with no session (/portal/login, 401 on the API). A Confidential supporting Document is now a second file-level negative check.
Marking a Knowledge Document Confidential needs an Administrator seat. A Legal Team Member walkthrough must hand that step to Daniel Okafor, or it loses sight of the file (see productBugs).
MCP Knowledge reads for a Business User were checked from source only; MCP and API keys start off and need configure-mcp setup, so the walkthrough need not exercise them.
Only Placement Portal home was exercised in DOC-029; a request-type placement is still source-read only.
The prose adds a Confidential rule and changes the content hash, so the DOC-029 walkthrough cannot be kept as a copy-only review.

productBugs: apps/web/src/components/documents/documents-card.tsx canFlag and apps/api/src/modules/documents/routes.ts assertMayFlagConfidential let the uploader set Mark confidential on a Knowledge Document, but apps/api/src/lib/contract-access.ts documentAudienceScope lets only Administrators reach a Confidential Knowledge Document. A Legal Team Member who marks their own Knowledge file loses it at once and cannot clear the mark. This contradicts the CTR-022 rationale (an actor who cannot see their own flagged record is a data-loss bug) and the DECISIONS-DOCUMENTS actor set read against the KNW-004 2026-09-18 addendum; either the Knowledge actor set should be Administrator only or the uploader should keep reach.
